en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding
the performer of Tumatto entering the day of Arafaat. So heasws said: ‘His Tumatto is complete up to his cutting off the Talbiyyah’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One’s al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) is complete (if one arrives in ‘Arafat) until saying Talbiyah is stopped (at noontime on the day of ‘Arafah).”’
